verdict.rationale: Twenty documents kanban board views with grouping and saved custom views, and its workflow docs refer to deals reaching stages, so a visual pipeline exists as a first-party capability. However, the evidence never explicitly describes editing pipeline stages or moving deals by drag-and-drop. missing for 10: explicit documentation of customizable deal/opportunity stages, drag-and-drop card movement between stages, independent or hands-on corroboration of the pipeline board.
